summary: Quiet residential east kerb where cars park; homes 17-21 m away, steep.

best_section.where: East kerb of Sundridge Street, about 100 m up from the Seven Oaks end, beside the yellow-brick apartment block

drivers.seclusion: Homes 17-21 m away on this side, with trees between; more houses across the road.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street with parking along the kerb; room for a van where cars park.
drivers.traffic: Quiet local street, no through traffic.
drivers.convention: Cars park along this side, but no overnight convention; No Stopping 7-9am Mon-Fri signs exist elsewhere.

flags: Steep: about 8% grade, max 15.8% on the whole stretch
Signs: No Stopping 7-9am Mon-Fri and Any Time near the ends
Low-lying at the bottom end (6 m elevation)
sun_shade: Street trees shade much of the section, mainly from the east in the morning.
cannot_judge: Whether residents object to overnight vans
